QuestInfo.name: [Eluna Express] City in the Sky
QuestInfo.0: Talk with Eremos about the next destination.
QuestInfo.1: Eremos directs you to the next training destination in Orbis. He finds the floating city to be very interesting and recommends you hunt 1,000 monsters in the area.
QuestInfo.2: You've hunted enough monsters around Orbis. It's time to speak with Eremos.
